Tuesday Gravel Nights (Caloosa Riders)

Punta Gorda, FL · Babcock Webb Wildlife Management Area · Gravel

No-drop

Tuesday Gravel Nights (Caloosa Riders) is a gravel group ride in Punta Gorda, FL. It rolls every Tuesday at 5:15 pm from Babcock Webb Wildlife Management Area (Cecil Webb WMA). About 24 miles, gravel, 13-16 mph, no pace lines or close following; 21 or 28 miles (two loops). No-drop.

For visitors

No registration. Bring cash for parking. Gravel or mountain bike. Not a hammer fest: the leader says the point is to look at the trees and wildlife.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:15 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Expect 13-16 mph: steady — you'll breathe hard on the hills. It's no-drop: if you fall off the back, someone waits. That's the point of a group ride.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Tuesday Gravel Nights (Caloosa Riders) group ride

A Tuesday-evening gravel ride on the maintained dirt roads of the Babcock Webb wildlife area, north of Punta Gorda. It is no-drop, with no pace lines. Caloosa Riders run it as a break from road traffic.
